scope: D020 same-recipe local reproduction on the opened D018 ID corpus

method.candidate: D028 frame-wise projection of all 16 candidates, followed by repair-aware physics and diversity selection
method.selection_inputs: visible frame zero, selected mask, force vector, generated poses and projection correction
method.excluded_from_selection: reference futures, hidden physics and evaluation metrics

checkpoint.role: local D020 same-recipe reproduction; not the original TC2 artifact

interpretation: Repair-aware selection lowered single-reference ADE by 7.58% over projected first-four sampling while preserving complete tracking, zero penetration, zero wall clipping and zero-force stationarity. The strict quality gate still failed, so D037 is exploratory evidence for combining projection and candidate selection, not a promoted model.
limitations: the locally reproduced checkpoint is not byte-identical to the original TC2 D020 checkpoint
D018 was already opened for D036, so this is not confirmatory evidence
one checkpoint and one ID corpus only
16 candidates cost four times as many model samples as the four-future control

provenance.note: Hashes identify the measured snapshot; later changes were locked formatting and administrative renumbering from D032 to D037.
